llm.summary: This markdown-only skill is a disclosed guide for querying the Agent Times API, with expected external requests and no hidden code or persistence.

dimensions.detail: External network access is proportionate to an API documentation skill, and no local file, credential, profile, or broad indexing access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only artifact/SKILL.md, requires curl, and metadata sets always=false; no install scripts or executable payloads were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill provides copy-paste curl examples to a single external service; webhook subscription and paid web search are disclosed, but users should treat both as explicit opt-in actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The local skill adds no persistence or privilege escalation; the /subscribe endpoint creates an external webhook subscription that persists until deleted with the returned secret.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities are news, weather, crypto price, search, and topic-alert API calls, which match the stated live-context purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should be comfortable with sending search queries to agenttimes.live. Use /subscribe only with an intentional public HTTPS webhook URL and save the unsubscribe secret. Confirm before using the /search endpoint because it is documented as a paid x402 request.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The webhook registration sends a query, category, and callback URL to agenttimes.live, but the artifact plainly documents the POST body, unsubscribe secret, recurring notifications, and public-HTTPS restriction.
[E1] expected: The external POST is a disclosed API example for topic alerts, not hidden exfiltration; users should still only register webhook URLs they intend to share with the service.
